findings.detail: Rock Star Mergersub fair value 576 over total net assets 1,588,246 implies 0.0363% before rounding, not the printed 0.03%.
Truck-Lite fair value 890 over total net assets 1,588,246 implies 0.0560% before rounding, not the printed 0.05%.

rationale: Class 2/structured identity check. The filing's own total net assets anchor is 1,588,246 (thousands). The cited investment schedule rows print fair value and % of net assets values that do not satisfy fair_value / total_net_assets * 100 within normal two-decimal rounding: Rock Star 576 / 1,588,246 * 100 = 0.0363%, which should round to 0.04%, while the source prints 0.03%; Truck-Lite 890 / 1,588,246 * 100 = 0.0560%, which should round to 0.06%, while the source prints 0.05%. The flag is therefore grounded in raw source as a real identity/value defect rather than a missing-source ambiguity.
